about: A live run of T10-study-planner, recorded for replay.

value.name: Exam study planner
value.summary: Add your exam topics and the tool spreads them over your evening sessions in the next two weeks. Rules like "never Fridays" keep sessions off those days. Making flashcards from notes isn't part of this tool yet.

value.name: Flashcards from notes
value.summary: Paste notes with one "front: back" pair per line and press the button to turn them into flashcards. Your cards are kept and new ones are added to them.
